plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQ, QQQI, and SMH as they are flagged SELL or below stop.
Buy MSFT at 10% as a top-quality name with a strong scanner setup.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Returns will be modest, but risk is substantially reduced.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce overall leverage.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQ, QQQI, and SMH due to their SELL flags or being below stop.
Buy SNOW at 4% as a strong scanner setup in quality tech.
This plan balances risk and growth, reducing concentration.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for around 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate drawdowns with a focus on sustainable growth.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, to lean into leveraged ETFs.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQ, QQQI, and SMH due to their SELL flags or being below stop.
Buy SNOW at 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in strong setups for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lose a lot fast; strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to rotate into an income-focused ETF.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQ, SMH, and CRWD to reduce high-beta exposure and exit flagged holdings.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth, rotating into income-focused ETFs. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
